proposal.reason: Main functional change is GIN-specific P2P traffic balancing across LAG members in both GDAKI and PROXY paths (QP affinity selection/rotation, capability gating, and read-back validation), plus related GIN context/setup behavior updates (including PROXY accepting nonzero queue depth). The mlx5/DOCA wrapper additions are enabling plumbing for this same GIN networking behavior, not an independent module change.
